name: Miguel Angel Hernandez Jr.
office: East Whittier City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Miguel Angel Hernandez Jr. is a police officer. He says he has been a school volunteer.
He says the district's top needs are proper funding for educational support and staff morale. He believes the board should hold the superintendent accountable and establish effective policies.
